findings.title: Allow input methods to handle Control shortcuts
findings.message: Every Control-modified key commits the current composition before the input context can interpret it. Input methods use Control shortcuts themselves—for example, Japanese input uses Control-J and Control-K for script conversion. Those shortcuts will prematurely commit the preedit and reach the application rather than performing conversion.
findings.suggestion: Let the input context handle composition-related modified keys first, and only commit and forward an application shortcut if the input context does not consume it. Do not classify every Control-modified event as an application shortcut.

findings.title: Do not recreate an invalidated composition baseline
findings.message: After an external publication supplies marked text or invalidates the restoration baseline, the next setMarkedText call recreates that baseline from an already-composing document. Escape then restores partially composed text and unmarks it instead of refusing cancellation, contrary to the explicit baseline policy in finish and vellum_input_update.
findings.suggestion: Capture a restoration baseline only when starting a new composition from an unmarked document. Keep the baseline unavailable throughout an externally supplied or externally modified composition.

findings.title: Persist idle measurements in the experiment report
findings.message: The idle measurement is printed but never delivered to the existing "idle" message handler. Consequently, f.idle remains empty and saved reports contain no idle_samples even when --idle-sample is enabled.
findings.suggestion: Send the completed sample through the pump so the UI-thread handler appends it to f.idle before the report is saved; do not append directly from the timer goroutine.
